SELECT
    if(d.IsHoliday = 'Yes', 'Holiday', 'Non-Holiday') AS day_type,
    countDistinct(fos.SalesOrderNumber) AS online_orders,
    sum(fos.SalesAmount) AS revenue
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS fos
INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d
    ON fos.DateKey = d.DateKey
WHERE d.CalendarYear = 2009
GROUP BY day_type
ORDER BY day_type
